overview.about: The World University Games - the Universiade - is the largest multi-sport event after the Olympics, bringing together thousands of student-athletes from around the world. Many future Olympic champions made their name here first. The 2027 Summer edition is hosted across Germany's Rhine-Ruhr region.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Summer World University Games are staged across the Rhine-Ruhr region of western Germany. Organised by FISU, they combine Olympic sports with a festival for the global student community across several host cities.
